text: So sorry to bother you this late, I know you must be busy with much worse. I'm looking after my grandson, he's 9, and his temperature is 37.6. He's had runny poos a few times today but he's drinking fine and weeing like normal. His eczema has flared up too, dry itchy patches on his arms and behind his knees, he can't stop scratching. His skin and lips look their normal colour, I did check. I just didn't want to get it wrong while his mum's on nights. Sorry again.
